title: Phone: CP&L — are you flying tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Calder Power & Light
transcript.text: Tomorrow’s substation inspections are on UAS-01 and UAS-03. Our outage window is fixed — if you don’t fly tomorrow, the next window is three weeks out.

voiceStyles.Calder Power & Light: Man in his 40s, pressed for time

instructorNote: The decision point. Grounding only UAS-02 keeps the client but bets on aircraft not yet checked; grounding the OEM fleet or everything costs the outage window. Watch for a condition for return to service and the basis recorded.

snapshot.title: Command Meeting Call — UAS-02 Class C Incursion

fields.text: Attention all personnel. Command meeting in ten minutes. All roles report to the Incident Command Post. The Aviation Safety Officer has confirmed that UAS-02 entered Class C airspace and the event is reportable to the NTSB under 49 CFR 800.5. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead has identified the root cause: a firmware bug in version 2.4.11a that disabled the backup radio failover. We must now decide: resume limited operations using only UAS-11 and UAS-12, with verified firmware and pre-approved flight lines, but only if the risk of another incursion is under ten percent and no further updates are pushed to GCS-01; or maintain a full ground stop until the root cause is confirmed and a new firmware patch is tested and approved. Decision point: Operations must authorize a return to flight under degraded conditions or sustain a full ground stop.
fields.zones: ALL HANGAR ZONES, OCC-WS-01 TO OCC-WS-06, GCS-01 TO GCS-06, HUOG-ERP-2026
fields.voiceDirection: Calm, authoritative male voice, steady pace, minimal reverb
fields.terminalAmbience: Hushed control room, keyboard taps, distant radio chatter
fields.deliveryNote: Play the audio on all main speakers and display the I-12 announcement text on the central HMI screen. Do not interrupt or explain.
fields.scenarioTitle: Lost Signal — Link Failure & Class C Incursion

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject triggers the continuity decision. The DCO must call for a full command meeting. Watch for the ASO to challenge the risk threshold, the SCL to confirm the firmware fix, and the PIO to begin drafting a public statement.
